semiconductor_relevance: High — Ohmplus Technology Inc. specializes in high-efficiency RF and phased-array measurement technologies, which are critical for testing semiconductor devices in the RF and communications sectors.
summary: Ohmplus Technology Inc. provides integrated solutions for high-throughput measurement and testing in the semiconductor industry, focusing on RF and phased-array technologies. Their offerings include advanced OTA wireless testing systems and multi-site ATE solutions designed to optimize test time and costs for RF IC and FEM manufacturers.
capabilities: OTA wireless testing systems for antennas and AiP modules
Multi-site ATE group testing solutions for RF FEM devices
